body.statement: There is a universal constant \(c>0\) such that, with probability \(1-o(1)\) over \(G_n\), \[R_2(G)\ge c r(n,d).\] The bound holds simultaneously against every outcome-independent assignment law and every measurable possibly biased or randomized estimator on \(\mathcal M_2(G)\).
body.justification: A stable-set upper bound is not an optimal-design theorem without an all-procedure converse on the same endpoint class.
body.gap: The published random-regular lower bound is only of order \(d/n\); the balanced two-arm packing and Bayes reduction must deliver the stronger logarithmic scale without restricting the estimator.
body.consumer: The converse certifies that no cluster, conflict-priority, nonlinear, or biased procedure can improve the capsule's degree dependence by more than a universal constant.
